Modal Title

Settings Guide

Overview

Adjust extension-wide settings such as Live Assistant behaviour, import/export, and locator management.

Tips

  • Enable Live Assistant to show quick fill suggestions on input focus.
  • Right click to any input field then choose menu of this extension (Freak Filler) then choose [Open Filling Assistant].
  • You can get all query selector of all component in page with right clicking on it then choose menu of this extension (Freak Filler) then choose [Get element selector].
  • Manage locators to prioritize reliable selectors (data-testid).
  • Use import/export to backup or move settings between machines.
  • Use sample prompts to generate JSON data from automation test code to extension data
  • All confirmation modals/ dialogs will listen to key down: [Enter] for confirming, [Esc] for canceling

Locator Management Guide

What are Locators?

Locators are the selectors used to identify and target form fields on web pages. The extension tracks all unique locators across your presets and saved values.

Types of Locators

  • data-testid: Preferred - most reliable and stable across page updates
  • querySelector: Fallback - CSS selector used when testid is not available

Best Practice: Use data-testid attributes whenever possible. They're specifically designed for automation and remain stable when developers update CSS classes or HTML structure.

Usage Count

Shows how many times each locator appears across all your presets and saved values. Higher counts indicate more widely-used locators.

Managing Locators

  • Quickly modify a filed in all your data at 1 time
  • Review duplicate or similar locators
  • Identify which fields are most commonly filled
  • Spot potential issues with selector reliability

Pages Management Guide

What are Pages?

Pages are profiles for specific URLs where you want to auto-fill forms. Each page can have multiple presets and saved values associated with it.

Page Properties

  • Page Title: Friendly name for easy identification
  • URL: The web address where this page profile applies
  • Description: Optional notes about the page's purpose
  • Owner: Optional field to track who manages this page
  • URL Match Type: How the URL is matched

URL Match Types

  • Exact Match: Only activates on the exact URL specified
  • Prefix Match: Activates on any URL starting with the specified prefix (useful for pages with dynamic IDs or query parameters)

Pro Tip: Use Prefix Match for login pages or forms that exist on multiple similar URLs. For example, https://example.com/admin/ will match all admin pages.

Managing Pages

  • Add Page: Create a new page profile from scratch
  • Edit: Modify page properties directly in the table
  • Delete: Remove page and all associated presets/saved values
  • Import/Export: Backup or share page configurations

Presets Management Guide

What are Presets?

Presets are complete form configurations containing all field values needed to auto-fill a form. They can be reused across multiple pages.

Preset Properties

  • Name: Descriptive identifier for the preset
  • Description: Optional details about the preset's purpose
  • Fields Count: Number of form fields configured in this preset
  • Linked Pages: How many page profiles use this preset
  • Last Updated: Timestamp of the most recent modification

Preset Linking

Presets can be linked to multiple pages, making them reusable:

  • Create a preset once
  • Link it to multiple page profiles
  • Update the preset in one place to affect all linked pages

Use Case: Create a "Login Credentials" preset and link it to all your login pages. When you change your password, update the preset once and it works everywhere.

Managing Presets

  • Add Preset: Create a new preset with form fields
  • Edit: Open the preset editor to modify field values
  • Delete: Remove preset (will unlink from all pages)
  • Import/Export: Share presets or move between systems

Best Practices

  • Use clear, descriptive names for presets
  • Group related presets by purpose (e.g., "Dev Environment", "Production")
  • Regularly export presets as backups
  • Keep field count reasonable (10-20 fields per preset)

Keyboard Shortcuts

Ctrl + F - Find in table

Automation Prompts

Use Prompts

Select a prompt from the dropdown to view it. Click Copy to copy the displayed prompt to clipboard. Remember to replace {{ ... }} placeholders with your own context before running the co-pilot.

Filling Assistant Default Settings

Overview

Configure how the Filling Assistant behaves when interacting with input fields across websites.

Options

  • Show on input click: Toggle whether the assistant opens when an input is clicked.
  • Show saving value section: Show the saved-values panel in the assistant for quick reuse.
  • Default save to: Choose whether saved items are stored under Saved Values or Presets by default.
  • Show import value section: Show the import UI inside the assistant for pasting prompt results or saved values.

How to Open the Filling Assistant

  1. Click into any input field on a page (if Show on input click is enabled) or right click on it the choose the menu [Freak Filler] then choose [Open Filling Assisant].
  2. Or use the context menu action Show Filling Assistant (right-click on an editable field).
  3. From the popup you can choose presets, saved values, or run small actions like clicking a button on the page.

Tip: Enable the save section if you frequently reuse values across pages. Use presets when values are shared across multiple pages.

Troubleshooting

  • Don't see the Regex Pattern section even though it's enabled? There may be no regex pattern data defined yet. Add one in the Regex Patterns section first.
  • Don't see Saving Value or Import Value sections in the assistant? The current page profile may not have been created for the active tab. Create or link a page profile for this site (Pages section) so saved values and importable data are available.

Random String Configuration

Purpose

Configure the default character set and length used when generating random strings from the extension.

Default Character Set

Choose which characters are included when generating strings. The available options mean:

  • Alphabet: Lowercase and uppercase letters (a-z, A-Z).
  • Numeric: Digits only (0-9).
  • Alphabet & numeric: Letters and digits (a-z, A-Z, 0-9).
  • Alphabet, numeric & special: Letters, digits and common punctuation/symbols (e.g. !@#$%^&*()).
  • Alphabet, numeric, special & control: All previous characters plus control characters (tabs, newlines). Use with caution—control characters may not be valid for many input fields.

Default Length

Set a sensible default for generated strings. You can override the length from the popup or modal when generating one-off values.

Regex Patterns

What are Regex Patterns?

Regex patterns are reusable regular expressions you can apply in the Filling Assistant to validate or transform input values before saving or applying them.

How to Use

  • Create a named pattern and provide the regular expression in the table.
  • Use the patterns in the Filling Assistant to quickly apply validation or to generate suggested values.
  • The order of the rows data below will be determine the order of import regex buttons in Filling Assistant popup

Examples

Digits Only
^\d{4,10}$ — matches a string of digits with length between 4 and 10 (e.g. "123456").
Extract domain
@([\w.-]+)\.[a-zA-Z]{2,} — captures the domain portion from an email-like input (useful for parsing).

Tip: You can ask the co-pilot (see Prompts Guide) to generate or explain regex patterns for you. For example, request "create a regex to validate US phone numbers" and paste the result into the patterns table.

Field Length Configuration

Purpose

Define expected lengths for specific fields or selectors.

The default value of characters quantity in Random String section in Filling Assistant based on target element:

  • Highest priority: The character length value defined in this data grid (Field Length Configuration).
  • Lower priority: The element's maxlength attribute (if present on the input element).
  • Lowest priority: The default length from Random String Configuration.

How to Configure

  • Add a configuration with a friendly name, locator (data-testid or selector), and max length.
  • Use the locator field to target specific inputs on pages.

For each test case or flow that interacts with the page, locate the form fields it uses (selectors, test ids, values, types, and any delays or blur behavior) and create a Preset object for that test case if one doesn't already exist.

Produce a single JSON payload matching the Freak Filler extension storage format with the following top-level structure: pages (array), presets (array), presetPageLinks (array), savedValues (array, optional), and settings (optional).

Requirements:
- Use GUIDs for IDs and ISO 8601 timestamps for createdAt/updatedAt.
- Use exactMatch or prefixMatch for page matching; prefer exactMatch if the test uses the full URL.
- Group test cases that are semantically identical into one preset when they use the same field sets and values.
- For each field include these properties: id, type, title, value, testId, querySelector, fillDelay, autoBlur, order, createdAt, updatedAt.
- Prefer stable selectors in this order: data-testid, id, name, then other CSS selectors.
- Output only the JSON object — do not include extra comments or surrounding text.

Field detection rules:
- id: new GUID
- type: one of the FIELD_TYPES (text, search, checkbox, radio, dropdown, datepicker, dynamicDate, range, number, color, clickable, htmlEditor)
- title: best user-facing label (from label, aria-label, placeholder, name, data-testid, id)
- value: literal value to set (string/number/boolean) or JSON for dynamicDate
- testId: data-testid attribute if available
- querySelector: robust CSS selector used in the test
- fillDelay: ms (default 0)
- autoBlur: boolean (default false)
- order: integer 1..n (preserve test flow order)
- createdAt and updatedAt: ISO timestamps

Notes:
- You can add an optional top-level settings object matching ExtensionSettings if you want to include extension-level flags like enableLiveAssistant.
- For dynamicDate use a value like {"years":0,"months":0,"days":-7} to indicate offsets.

      Given a single test case or flow identified by {TEST_ID_OR_FILEPATH}, scan the executed steps or selectors that interact with the target page and produce one Preset JSON object matching the Freak Filler extension format.

Output requirements:
- Output exactly one JSON object with the keys: id, name, description, formData, createdAt, updatedAt.
- Each formData entry must include: id, type, title, value, testId, querySelector, fillDelay, autoBlur, order, createdAt, updatedAt.
- Preserve the test case field order as order.
- Use stable selectors (prefer data-testid, id, name).
- Default fillDelay to 0 and autoBlur to false unless the test shows timing/blur behavior.
- Output only the single JSON object (no wrapper arrays or extra text).

Example JSON (single preset):

{
  "id": "9a8b7c6d-5e4f-3210-9876-54321fedcba0",
  "name": "Signup - Happy Path",
  "description": "Signup flow: valid new user",

      "type": "text",
      "title": "First name",
      "value": "Alice",
      "testId": "signup-first",
      "querySelector": "input[name=\"firstName\"]",
      "fillDelay": 20,
      "autoBlur": true,
      "order": 1,
      "createdAt": "2026-01-08T09:30:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-01-08T09:30:00.000Z"
    },
    {
      "id": "22334455-6677-8899-aabb-ccddeeff0011",
      "type": "text",
      "title": "Last name",
      "value": "Example",
      "testId": "signup-last",
      "querySelector": "input[name=\"lastName\"]",
      "fillDelay": 10,
      "autoBlur": false,
      "order": 2,
      "createdAt": "2026-01-08T09:30:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-01-08T09:30:00.000Z"
    },
    {
      "id": "33445566-7788-99aa-bbcc-ddeeff001122",
      "type": "text",

Import tips:
- If the extension import UI expects a top-level object with presets array, wrap this object into {"presets": [ ... ]}.
- When importing page-level JSON, ensure presetPageLinks reference the correct pageId present in pages.
- Deduplicate identical presets and normalize selectors (prefer data-testid) when possible.
